user.title: Smartmeter
user.description: The smart meter must be connected via a M-BUS to USB converter. Please select the serial port of your USB device. Entries under /dev/serial/by-id/ are recommended, because they keep their name after a restart or when other USB devices are plugged in.

error.cannot_open_serial_port: Cannot open the serial port. Check that the device exists and is not used by another integration or add-on (e.g. ZHA, Zigbee2MQTT, another smart meter integration).
error.no_data: No smart meter data was received on this port. Check that this is the M-BUS adapter of the meter, the wiring, and that the selected supplier is correct.
error.cannot_decode: Data was received from the meter but could not be decrypted. Check the key and the supplier.
error.invalid_key: The key must consist of 32 hexadecimal characters (0-9, A-F).

abort.no_serial_ports: No com ports found. Need a valid M-BUS to USB device to communicate

init.title: Smart meter settings
init.description: Change the USB port of the M-BUS adapter and the update interval. Entries under /dev/serial/by-id/ are recommended.

error.data_interval_empty: Please enter an update rate between 5 and 3600 seconds.
error.data_interval_wrong: Update rate must be between 5 and 3600 seconds.
error.wrong_device: A different smart meter is connected to this port
error.cannot_open_serial_port: Cannot open the serial port. Check that the device exists and is not used by another integration or add-on (e.g. ZHA, Zigbee2MQTT, another smart meter integration).
error.no_data: No smart meter data was received on this port. Check that this is the M-BUS adapter of the meter, the wiring, and that the selected supplier is correct.
error.cannot_decode: Data was received from the meter but could not be decrypted. Check the key and the supplier.
